author: GitHub Copilot (GPT-5.1-Codex)
purpose: Define the governance scope for Phase 3 benchmarking so playlist evidence, dashboard diffs, and human summaries remain synchronized.
objectives: Expand playlist coverage with dashboard-first regression checks
Persist historical dashboard snapshots for governance diffs
Automate markdown surfaces (SYSTEM_STATUS / SYSTEM_SUMMARY) from dashboard JSON

governance_alignment.I1_function_determinism: Reuse catalog scenarios and pytest targets with fixed inputs so dashboard diffs reflect deterministic runs.
governance_alignment.I2_memory_isolation: Dashboard generation only reads log + JSON artifacts; no new caches beyond existing benchmarking_runner state.
governance_alignment.I3_workspace_coherence: All Phase 3 artifacts remain JSON-first under ai_docs/ and logs/benchmarks/ per core_reference.
governance_alignment.I4_documentation_purity: SYSTEM_STATUS.md and SYSTEM_SUMMARY.md will cite dashboard data rather than embed bespoke logic.

playlists.description: Baseline playlist to confirm dashboard coverage + presentation diffs before governance export.
success_criteria: Dashboard shows status="full" for every scenario in the playlist
Diff summary lists aggregate metric deltas against the previous playlist artifact
Automation ledger records scenario + aggregate entries (auto-0007) with playlist reference

playlists.description: Extended playlist that stitches TinyLLaMA demos with ledger-driven pytest to stress dashboard diffs.

telemetry_expectations.knowledge_base_sync: kb_index automation counters increment once per playlist

success_criteria: Benchmarking runner emits playlist_diffs.scenario_regressions when latency exceeds threshold
Dashboard view_counts reflect every presentation view listed above
Knowledge base automation metrics remain in lock-step with automation_runs ledger

recent_runs.notes: Baseline playlist captured 3/3 scenarios and seeded the dashboard archive feed.
Regression playlist validated pytest hooks and produced the first governance diff snapshot.

dashboard_expectations.history_strategy: Archive each playlist run under logs/benchmarks/playlist.* and reference prior snapshot in diff_summary.baseline_artifact

success_metrics: At least two Phase 3 playlist runs recorded with dashboard diffs
SYSTEM_STATUS.md + SYSTEM_SUMMARY.md cite dashboard data instead of hand-written coverage notes
knowledge_base/kb_index.json timestamps match the latest playlist run
next_steps: Map hallucinator telemetry aliases so coverage flips to full once snapshots land in proofs
